summary: Consolidate Zoom Phone licenses to annual plan and tag invoices to central finance cost centers
description:
Issue summary:
We need to migrate our Zoom Phone seats from a set of monthly subscriptions across multiple billing admins to a single annual contract billed to our central finance cost center. Impact: Finance wants predictable annual invoicing and tagging to ENG-VOICE-2026; IT needs SCIM provisioning and SSO intact; Security requires audit trail for license changes.

Background:
- Current state: ~120 Zoom Phone seats split between two Zoom accounts (ACC-9876543 and ACC-1239987) with monthly billing. Multiple admins maintain licenses which complicates offboarding and cost allocation.
- Reason for change: Consolidate billing, lower unit cost via annual commit, enable centralized seat management and cost tagging.

Request:
- Procure an annual Zoom Phone enterprise plan for 120 seats under account ACC-9876543.
- Ensure invoice is issued to Redwood Inference central finance and include billing code ENG-VOICE-2026 on the invoice descriptor.
- Migrate all seats from ACC-1239987 into ACC-9876543 and deactivate duplicate billing admins.
- Confirm SCIM provisioning still maps groups: voice-admins, eng-voice, contractor-voice.
- Confirm SSO/OIDC configuration and role mappings remain unchanged.
- Capture a final migration runbook and change window (proposed: 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC).
acceptance_criteria: Single annual invoice issued to Redwood Inference with billing code ENG-VOICE-2026
SCIM group mappings preserved and tested in staging before cutover
SSO login and role-based provisioning verified for 3 sample users
Finance confirms PO applied and expense recorded to ENG-PLATFORM-03
steps_to_provision: 1) Procurement obtains quote and issues PO to Zoom sales (rep: Daniel Kim)
2) Zoom account admin initiates annual contract and requests seat transfer document
3) IT runs SCIM sync in staging and validates group-to-license mapping
4) Cutover during approved change window: transfer seats, disable extra admins, verify SSO/phone routing
5) Finance validates invoice contains billing_code and tags expense to ENG-PLATFORM-03
6) Update internal asset registry and Confluence page with new contract details
